reuse.why: All month-wide actions reuse getBulkBudgetCategories, and the new action also reuses averageToBudget, spreadsheet access, batching, and budget mutation helpers.

duplication.why: Eligibility rules and amount sign conversion remain shared rather than being repeated in individual actions.

placement.why: Selection policy stays in budget/actions.ts, while method registration and undo integration follow the existing budget/app.ts boundary.

scope.why: The changes address the requested budget actions, apart from an unrelated import reorder in schedules/app.ts.

maintainability.why: The design keeps exclusions centralized, passes the hidden-category option directly, and preserves the existing missing-group variation explicitly.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every changed month-wide action, including setLastMonthSpending, uses getBulkBudgetCategories and the existing mutation infrastructure.

disguised_duplication.where: The diff extends the existing shared selection definition without introducing reshaped copies of its policy.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories renames its existing includeHidden parameter to includeHiddenCategories; template and fixed-group exclusions are general policy additions, with no new caller-specific exceptions or bypasses.
